data.name: Chandran
data.gender_notes: Chandran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chandran is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chandra', which means 'Moon'. In Hindu mythology, Chandran is the name of the moon god. The moon is revered as a symbol of calmness, peace, and prosperity. This name is believed to bring good fortune, wisdom, and protection. The name Chandran carries the meaning “Moon God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandran usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine power of the moon and the cyclical nature of life.
data.etymology: Chandran belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chandran total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
